title: Guided capacity sculptor: progressive onboarding panels & microcopy for reserved GPU flows
creator: Jordan Liu
description: Design a compact, progressive onboarding flow that helps teams configure reserved GPU capacity, explain autoscale trade-offs, and show SLA implications. Deliverables include hi-fi panels, annotated screenshot set for the docs site, microcopy variants A/B, and export-ready assets for engineering and marketing.
tasks: Create 3 progressive panels: baseline, traffic-profile, cost-sla tradeoff
Draft microcopy variants (concise / explanatory) for each panel
Produce annotated screenshots for Console docs (desktop + tablet)
Export SVG/PNG assets and redlines for frontend implementation
Handoff meeting + asset link + storybook PR reference
acceptance_criteria: Three progressive panels with final microcopy approved by PM and Eng
Annotated screenshots uploaded to Drive and referenced in docs PR
All assets exported with naming convention and tokens, plus CSS redlines
Design tokens verified with frontend in handoff; no outstanding accessibility blockers
Handoff notes and implementation checklist added to ticket comments
comments: 2025-02-12 Jordan Liu: Kickoff - scoped flow with PM; agreed on 3 panel pattern to reduce cognitive load for new Dedicated users.
2025-02-14 Maya Thompson: Wireframes uploaded to Drive. Initial microcopy variants (concise / expanded) included. Requested traffic profile chart from data team.
2025-02-16 Marco Ruiz (Eng): Provided latency/cost numbers to display in tradeoff panel; suggested using 95th percentile latency and hourly reserved cost estimate.
2025-02-18 Priya Nair (PM): Prefer the concise microcopy by default; ask design to include an expandable 'learn more' for advanced users.
2025-02-20 Maya Thompson: Hi-fi assets complete (desktop). Started responsive adjustments for tablet. Added ARIA guidance to microcopy notes.
2025-02-22 Jordan Liu: Reviewed screenshots; left inline comments about emphasizing 'autoscale burst' labeling to avoid confusion with 'autoscale' toggles elsewhere.
2025-02-24 Maya Thompson: Updated screenshots with revised label. Exported SVGs and redlines. Prepared handoff slide deck for eng review on 2025-02-26.
2025-02-25 Marco Ruiz (Eng): Quick review - confirm we can surface 95th pctl latency and estimated reserved cost from runtime metrics. Filed ENG-20112 to add metric endpoint.
review_feedback: PM (Priya): Reduce jargon in the first panel. Replace 'provisioning cadence' with 'reservation length (hourly/weekly)'.
Eng (Marco): Replace example GPU SKU with 'reserved GPU pool' and avoid hard-coded counts; frontend will substitute values at render time.
Security (Lena): Ensure screenshots do not expose customer names or keys; scrubbed real tenant IDs from visuals.
Docs (Hannah): Need alt text drafts and short/long descriptions for the docs site; added checklist item to attachments.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: show actionable defaults vs. exposing advanced knobs. Chose progressive disclosure to keep initial onboarding light while supporting power users via 'advanced settings' link.
